title: Life emerges in any ergodic system with a Markov blanket

statements.text: Biological self-organization is an inevitable and emergent property of any ergodic random dynamical system that possesses a Markov blanket. The argument is offered as a heuristic proof backed by simulation.

sources.quote: suggesting that life—or biological self-organization—is an inevitable and emergent property of any (ergodic) random dynamical system that possesses a Markov blanket.
